question: I run a shop in Manitoba and ship a taxable office chair to a customer in Ontario. Should I charge Manitoba's sales taxes or Ontario HST on the delivery?
generated_answer:
As a Manitoba-based business, you should charge Manitoba's sales taxes (GST and PST) on the sale of the office chair. The tax rate would be 12% (5% GST + 7% PST). 

When shipping to Ontario, you would not charge Ontario's HST (13% - 8% federal GST + 5% provincial PST) because the sale took place in Manitoba. The customer in Ontario would be responsible for paying any applicable provincial sales tax on the purchase, but this would be done through their own provincial tax authority, not through you as the seller.

However, if you have a physical presence (e.g., a warehouse, office, or employee) in Ontario, you may need to register for and charge Ontario's HST. This is because having a physical presence in the province can trigger nexus, which means you are required to collect and remit sales tax for that province.

If you're unsure about your obligations, it's best to consult with a tax professional or the relevant tax authorities (Manitoba and Ontario) to ensure you're meeting all your tax obligations. 

Remember, the tax rate and rules can change, so always check the most current information from the relevant tax authorities. 

For more information, you can refer to the following resources:
- Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) - [Manitoba Sales Tax](https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/forms-publications/publications/rc4022/manitoba-sales-tax.html)
- Ontario Ministry of Finance - [Ontario Sales Tax (OST)](https://www.ontario.ca/page/ontario-sales-tax) 

Please note that this response is for general information purposes only and should not be considered as professional tax advice. Always consult with a tax professional for advice tailored to your specific situation. 

Also, if you're using an e-commerce platform or shipping software, ensure that it is set up to apply the correct tax rates based on the shipping address and your business location.
